To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the phage φYeO3 is the first close phage relative of T3 and T4 to be described.
the bacteriophage φYe03-12, a phage specific for Y. enterocolitica O:3, is a close relative of phages T3 andT7.
the bacteriophage φYe O3-12 is related to coliphage T3.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of phage φYeO3 as an alternative to antibiotics for the elimination of pathogenic Yersinia enteroclitica O:3 from food.
the isolation and characterization of bacteriophages infecting Y. enterocolitica.
the development and application of bacteriophage-based methods for detection and typing ofY. enterocolitica.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
φYeO 3-12 is an O:3-specific phage of Y. enterocolitica, closely related to T3 and T3-related phages.
phage φYeO3 is a T3-like phage.
φYeO 3-12 is related to phages T3 and/or T7.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
bacteriophage φYe03-12 is a new member of the T7-like phage group.
φYeO 3-12, a phage of Y. enterocolitica O:3, is related to coliphage T3 and is the first close T3 relative to be described.
φYeO 3-12 is related to phage T3, but not to phage T7.
The main takeaway from our work is that
phages of enterobacteria can have a close relationship with coliphages.
φYeO 3-12 is closely related to coliphages T7 and T3.
φYeO 3-12 can be used as a new model system for the study of phage T7-related phages.
